title: skills/docs: teach that a record-triggered flow's notify links to the trigger record when it writes no sourceObject, sourceId or actionUrl (#30121 Skills-docs follow-up)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZMkHvuDeVYgTD73qF

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #30252 (#30121, `Metadata-protocol: semantic`), filed by `domain:server` seat 4 as that line asks. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 (the runtime default ships in PR #30252; the teaching still says the link is dropped without a pair).

## What changes in the runtime (PR #30252)

A `notify` node that writes none of `sourceObject`, `sourceId` and `actionUrl` now links to the run's trigger record when the run has one: a record change other than a delete, a time-relative sweep's row, or an action started on a record. An explicit pair or `actionUrl` still wins. A half-written pair is still dropped. A run with no trigger record links nowhere.

## What still teaches the old rule

1. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:124`: the notify example's comment `// click-through: a PAIR, else dropped`. This is a governed (Tier H) path, so it needs a human approver.
2. `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` (the notify `sourceId` paragraph, around :351): it should say the default.
3. `packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts`: the `sourceObject` / `sourceId` `.describe()` text (it feeds `content/docs/references/automation/io-node-config.mdx` on regenerate). This is a spec-lane edit; triage may split it off.
4. Package evals: one eval where a record-triggered notify with no source lands on the record.

## Acceptance

Each surface states the default and its three exceptions (an explicit link wins, a half pair is dropped, no trigger record means no link). The node's own config-schema descriptions in `notify-node.ts` already say so after PR #30252; reuse that wording.

Blocked-by: PR #30252 merging (the text must not run ahead of the runtime).

Dedupe: searched `notify click-through default trigger record`, `PAIR, else dropped`; nearest #30121. **New.**

Links back: #30121, PR #30252.
